evt_genesis.description: Governs the first event of a Dimension's hashgraph: scope dimension, emitted by the opening players, final when signed by all of them. Payload fixes dimension ids, the rules snapshot commit, tileset_size WxH, the map_seed every later part derives hidden placement from, and the owners. The runtime deviates: peer.mjs emits an evt_genesis from EVERY peer at startup (each process starts its own tape rather than adopting the opener's), rules_snapshot_commit is the literal 'local', owners is hard-coded to ['peer:player-1'], an extra reveal_radius field is added and the signature is a stub. Context assumed: envelope {type, payload, actor_peer_id}, emitter {id, role}, scope, hashgraph.length, dimension.initial_size.

map_seed and rules_snapshot_commit are what make later parts reproducible; they must stay.

evt_join.description: Governs a peer entering through a Door: scope door, emitted by the joining peer, accepted by the strong-region members of the entry tile (or by itself when alone). Payload carries door_id, flow (open_dimension | join_near_friend | join_new_location), character / class ids, the deck commitment (hash of the shuffled deck order), entry_tile and the adopted head. The runtime deviates: flow is chosen by alliance (player -> open_dimension, else join_near_friend), class_id is null, an extra creature_id is sent, adopted_head is always null, deck_commitment is sha256 of the card-id list, and the event is appended locally without any acceptance round. Context assumed: envelope, emitter, scope, peers[] {tile, life}, region.strong.

evt_leave.description: Governs a peer leaving a Door: scope door, emitted by the leaving peer or by its strong region on timeout, gossiped and recorded at the next Radicle push. Payload: reason (voluntary | travel_door | timeout | desynced), the tile left, and the fixed flag that the character card stays on the tile as a map item. The runtime deviates: peer.mjs never emits evt_leave — a silent peer simply drops out of livePeers after 20 s without a snapshot, and summoned companions `vanish` locally; nothing marks the tile. Context assumed: envelope, emitter, scope, silence_s (seconds since the leaver's last envelope).

evt_action_commit.description: Governs phase 1 of the per-action handshake: scope strong_region, one commit per actor per action, final only when every strong-region member has committed. Payload: commitment = sha256 over action code, effect ids, skill ids, target and salt; empty_move_announced is true when the actor openly declares Empty Move (rule_6). The runtime deviates: the hash also covers trance options, the effect chain step, destroy stat and bonus-round plan; the commit is also sent over the Nostr bus and mirrored to an optional discovery server; the strong set is frozen at this moment (freezeRoundMembers) and stragglers are forfeited after COMMIT_WAIT_MS 800 (hard cap 2 x ROUND_SEC) rather than handshake_timeout_s. Context assumed: envelope, emitter, scope, phase, declared.action, commits_seen (ids for this action), region.strong.

evt_action_reveal.description: Governs phase 2 of the handshake: scope strong_region, each actor reveals action (actions.json code), effects, skills, class ability, target {kind, ref}, combo_step and the salt; peers verify sha256 against the commit. The runtime deviates: the action may also be 'BT' (a trance pair carried in `trance`), effects are full objects (id, elements, step/of, every, aura, summon ...) not ids, extra fields destroy / bonus / skill_names are sent, class_ability_tapped is always false and combo_step always null; the reveal is NOT verified against the commitment; reveals are waited for from the strong set PLUS every peer whose commit was seen, and every reveal held is resolved whatever tier its actor is in. Context assumed: envelope, emitter, scope, phase, commits_seen, reveal.recomputed_commitment, commit.commitment, region.strong.

evt_instant.description: Governs phase 3, the instant window: any strong-region member may respond with a skill, a point-buy destroy attempt (rule_24) or a class ability, or pass; the window closes when every member answered. The runtime deviates: peer.mjs has no instant phase or pass message — instants (effects flagged is_instant), skills and the point-buy `destroy` all ride inside evt_action_reveal and are resolved in the same deterministic pass; rule 8 pc override returns a no-benefit instant to hand. Context assumed: envelope, emitter, scope, region.strong, responded (ids), caster (unit), token {power, is_class_card, element}, die.

evt_dice.description: Governs the audit record of a D6 derivation: scope strong_region, emitted by the peer applying the roll, verifiable by all. Payload: purpose (monster_action | point_buy | trap_power | other), roll_index, the salts used and the resulting 1..6 values; the contract derives roll = 1 + (sha256(concat(salts) + roll_index) mod 6). The runtime deviates: evt_dice is never emitted; dice come from effects.mjs rollDice(seed) = successive bytes of sha256(seed) mod 6 + 1 where the seed is the ACTOR's own reveal salt + purpose + action index (not the concatenation of all members' salts), so the roll is reproducible by every peer but is not bias-resistant against the actor. Context assumed: envelope, emitter, scope, salt_digest_int, stat.

evt_state_hash.description: Governs phases 4/5: every strong-region member runs the deterministic resolver, signs the resulting state hash, and the action is final on unanimous match; a mismatch is a dispute. Payload: state_hash, damage_applied [{target, amount, source}], tokens_changed [{tile, token, op}]. The runtime deviates: the hash covers only the entities inside the EMITTER's strong set, so two peers' hashes legitimately differ and checkStateHash compares entity by entity (tile, life) instead, logging 'STATE DIVERGENCE' without any dispute or replay; the payload adds region, bonus_rounds, vanished, journey_results and actions, tokens_changed is always [], and the event is not relayed over the Nostr bus. Context assumed: envelope, emitter, scope, reveals_seen, region.strong, hashes_seen (list), responders, mine.state_hash.

evt_turn_commit.description: Governs the once-per-turn gossip to reachable and far regions: scope dimension, emitted by one elected member per strong region (lowest peer_id hash), merging additively. Payload: turn, region_state_hash, map_delta, positions, hashgraph_head and the draws (rule_10 refill to 5). The runtime deviates: every peer emits its own evt_turn_commit at its turn boundary (endRound) — no election; map_delta is absent (map blocks travel separately), positions are axial {q,r} for every peer heard, draws covers only the emitter; it is sent over libp2p only. Context assumed: envelope, emitter, scope, round, clock.rounds_per_turn, region.lowest_hash_member, caster.hand_size, peers[].

evt_map_extend.description: Governs adding a block of tiles and a new DoorId when a peer joins at a new location: scope dimension, pushed to Radicle immediately, accepted by others on poll. Payload: new_door_id, block_origin, block_size WxH (= the initial tileset), block_seed derived from map_seed + block_origin, rooted_at_head. The runtime deviates: peer.mjs emits evt_map_extend whenever revealAround discovers hexes (a disc block of reveal radius 10 around a position, grow-only), not only on join_new_location; the payload is {block} with the block's q,r,radius,by,at; it is relayed over the Nostr bus and complemented by an evt_map_sync event (not in this vocabulary) carrying whole block lists. Context assumed: envelope, emitter, scope, join.flow, dimension.doors, dimension.tileset.initial_size, dimension.map_seed.

evt_merge.description: Governs two unmet hashgraph parts becoming one: scope dimension, emitted by all strong-region members present at first contact, signed by all present. Payload: heads_merged, common_ancestor, door_ids_unified, conflicts_resolved [{tile, winner, rule}], turn_adopted = max(turn). The runtime deviates: evt_merge is never emitted; peer.mjs has no part merge (see sync_divergence_merge) — the only convergence is the grow-only union of map blocks and the max-turn clock rule. Context assumed: envelope, emitter, scope, region.strong, signers, parts.a / parts.b.

evt_radicle_push.description: Governs the audit record of an interval push: scope door, emitted by the elected pusher, gossiped. Payload: interval_index = floor(unix_time / radicle_push_interval_s), the git commit on ActiveDimensions/<DimensionName>, head_pushed. The runtime deviates: every peer emits one after each of its own door pushes (every RADICLE_PUSH_SEC = 60 s, no lottery); the payload is {door, commit, head_pushed, explorer_url, tree_url} without interval_index. Context assumed: envelope, emitter, scope, now_s, lottery.winner, me.id.

evt_vote.description: Governs an in-game governance vote: scope dimension, any player, gossiped and tallied at the governance interval. Payload: entry_id, proposal version, signal (+1 | -1 | abstain), usage_evidence {times_used_in_dimension, turns_held} and an optional counter_proposal. The vote weight follows governance_voting: w = 0.01 x (1 + log2(1 + times_used)) x (1 + 0.1 x dimensions_played_in), capped at 0.10 per peer per proposal; json-logic has no log2 so the runtime supplies log2_1p_times_used = log2(1 + times_used_in_dimension). The runtime deviates: evt_vote is never emitted and there is no tally — tools/rebalance.mjs appends proposal versions at weight 0 directly. Context assumed: envelope, emitter {id, pubkey}, scope, votes_seen_keys (peer:entry:version strings), log2_1p_times_used, dimensions_played_in.
